title: Uniform proper bound on the coefficient-relative ind heart
statement: Fix universes u and u+1, a prime ell, a field k in Type u of positive prime characteristic different from ell, separated finite-type k-schemes Z and Y and a proper k-morphism g:Z to Y. Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring with its specified multiplication certified by IsEllAdicCoefficient [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]. Let Lambda_Z and Lambda_Y be its pulled-back coefficients and Rg_* the ordinary internal-module total right derived pushforward [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. There exists c in Nat such that, for every Lambda_Z-module sheaf M in the ambient u+1-small filtered-colimit closure of IsConstructibleModuleObject Lambda_Z [def-sfb-constructible-module], H^j(Rg_*(M[0])) is zero for every integer j>c. The bound is uniform in M, including zero objects and empty fibres.

source.place: Intermediate step of the proper truncation-tail argument

proof.text: Choose a bound on source dimension; geometric fibre dimension does not increase under base change. For continuous finite field coefficients, embed the field in PadicAlgCl and transport constructibility, ind objects, and the derived proper image through the actual coefficient isomorphism. Local finite freeness permits the canonical constant-model proper heart bound. Faithful coefficient restriction reflects homology vanishing.
For PadicAlgCl coefficients use the same local-free comparison and the algebraic-closure proper heart bound.

For integral coefficients use the uniform constructible-heart bound. Present any ind object as its ambient filtered constructible colimit. Bounded-below continuity, applied to degree-zero single complexes, identifies cohomology of its proper image with the colimit of the vanishing stage cohomologies.

theorem ellAdic_proper_heart_upper_bound :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z.left) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ Z.left),
      ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1}
        (IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ Z.left)) M →
      ∀ j : ℤ, (c : ℤ) < j →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ j).obj
          ((R((g.left)_*⟦Λ⟧)).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))
